'''Masken''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] who served aboard [[Darth Vengean]]'s flagship during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the Sith Empire.

==Biography==
{{GameDS}}
In [[3642 BBY]], Masken was onboard [[Darth Vengean]]'s [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] locked in a [[Battle for Darth Vengean's flagship|space battle]] with Republic [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Monk (Human)|Monk]] over [[Quesh]].<ref name="Ambush!" /> When [[Empire's Wrath|the apprentice]] of [[Darth Baras]] docked with the vessel, Masken assumed that Darth Baras was betraying [[Darth Vengean]] in a [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith]] struggle at the cost of Imperial lives and revealed to the [[Sith Warrior]] that Admiral Monk and his top men had already fled in an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]] to the planet below. The Warrior executed the indignant [[Moff/Legends|Moff]], and then proceeded down to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].
{{Endgame}}
